name: Dalia Hosny
subject: first Arab pro in the ring
hook_quote: the first Arab professional Thai Boxing fighter

beats.hook: You were the first Arab professional Thai Boxing fighter. Nobody ahead of you to ask how, so I'll skip the advice.
beats.identity: I'd bring you meetings. 12 for the last business coach I worked with in Dubai, and 5 of them turned into clients.
beats.offer: I've already got 10 names for you. Real people here, picked one at a time.
beats.cta: 15 minutes and they're yours the same day. I'll tell you why these 10 and not the other 40.
beats.ps: ps: a no costs you nothing, and beats a maybe.
